4C43010000000001|Every coin the Guild struck carried the Horizon Engine on one side. I kept one in my boot for luck. Given how things turned out, I want my money back.
4C43010000000015|The Horizon Exchange kept the Aerie's accounts, every last coin. Their machines stood on every corner of the city, and some of them kept working long after the people stopped.
4C43010000000019|On the Aerie, every square meter of deck was paid for. On the ground, it seems the old rules still apply.
4C4301000000001B|When money ran short, the Aerie's outer districts went dark first. In its last years the Exchange quietly darkened three of them to keep the Engine fed. Nobody up top noticed.
4C43010000000035|The Exchange ledger for the Engine refit shows a single payment, in full and in advance, from the Consortium. Signed: I. Vess. Whatever the Director says now, she paid for that night.
4C43010000000063|The Exchange outlived the Grounding because people will always need to trade. Its bells ring again. Somewhere above the clouds, someone is hearing them for the first time in a long while.
